contexts.text: Terminate finally in the most general covering, which is the skull.
The brain, when denuded of the skull.
See Skin. DMin 4597.

Pains are sometimes felt in the skull, now in one part, now in another, and as it were nuclei are perceived there which are separated from the rest of the bones... Such things come forth from the false things which are from cupidities; and the genera and species of the falsities have their own definite places in the skull. Explained.
Hence those who have lived in deadly hatred... and the derivative falsities, have their skulls completely indurated; and some have skulls like ebony, through which no rays of light can penetrate.
(Such) relate to deadly tumours of the head within the skull.

They who love mere Knowledges... relate to the interior membrane of the skull. And they who accustom themselves to speak without affection, and to draw the thought to themselves, and withdraw it from others, relate to this membrane ossified. SE 3888.
Like the brain without... its general covering, containant, and support, which is called the skull.
A part of the skull was again raised up towards Heaven, and there was as it were read therein of what character the person had been... SE 2468, Explained.
They have attracted my skull, sometimes with pain. Explained.
Things corporeal and natural constitute as it were the skull with its hair.
The falsities which indurate the skull are natural falsities...
On those who constitute deadly ulcers... within the skull.
a. (The Sirens) are carried through the pores of the bone of the skull towards the external skin.
Spirits who adhered to the head, so as to occupy the bones of the skull. Explained. SE 3912.
Like the bones of the skull, which are of the same substance as the coats of the brain, [which] however, decrease into bones, and defend from injuries.
Lejel had an operation into the skull, inducing pains on the part above the cerebrum, and afterwards on the part above the cerebellum.
Witches enter into all parts of the skull and body, and thus find out what Societies are excited.
Hypocrites inflict pain on the very bones of the skull. DMin 4648.
They hatched a theology from their skull.
